run_generate_documents: run the script to parse RCV1/RCV2 XML corpus files and extract topic-labeled documents
run_rcv_corpus_indexing: run the script with an indices file to index XML documents from the RCV corpus
run_xml_topic_extraction: run the script to extract bip:topics:1.0 category labels from RCV XML documents
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional topic classes beyond C, E, G, M
review_main: review the main function and its XML parsing logic for RCV1/RCV2 document extraction
